description: Fir Extract FIR 141/2024, PS Samana at PS Samana (Patiala): Cheating, Fraud & Forgery

metadata.text: [Public record · High Court of Punjab and Haryana, CRM-M-38874-2025, order dated 2025-09-02 · names pseudonymised] Facts as recorded in the order: the aforesaid FIR was registered against the petitioner [Accused A1], who was working on the post of Secretary in “The [Name W1] Co-operative Society” (hereinafter referred to as – the Society), at the instance of one [Name W2] [Name W3], Assistant Registrar of the Society, alleging therein that the petitioner had committed embezzlement of funds to the tune of Rs.29717/-, Rs.31,500/- and Rs.2,440/- during the financial year 2019-20. Court proceedings: petition for anticipatory bail by [Accused A1]; outcome: Allowed. The order mentions criminal antecedents without listing them.
